frontier_selector.why: The evidence of blood and wound cultures growing Klebsiella pneumoniae along with the abdominal ultrasound revealing a liver abscess specifically supports Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess.

support_spans: Blood and wound cultures grew Klebsiella pneumoniae
Abdominal Ultrasound: Revealed an 8.4 × 11 × 13 cm liver abscess
Medical history includes alcohol use disorder and newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes (hemoglobin A1c of 7.5%)
Initial MRI: Showed left mid-tibia osteomyelitis with an adjacent abscess and right third toe osteomyelitis
